about-page.title: About
about-page.description-1: Frontend Engineer (React/TypeScript) with 5 years of commercial web application development experience and more than 10 years of IT background.
about-page.description-2: I specialize in creating scalable SPA applications using React and TypeScript, including working with SSR/SSG (Next.js ). I have experience in designing application architecture (Feature-Sliced Design), designing and developing a design system, as well as optimizing performance based on Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS).
about-page.description-3: In my work, I focus not only on the development of functionality, but also on the impact on the product: I improve the loading speed and responsiveness of interfaces (code splitting, lazy loading, memoization), increase stability through unit and integration testing (Jest, React Testing Library), and also participate in the development of development processes and CI/CD.
about-page.description-4: I have experience working with REST API (Axios), WebSockets and modern state management tools (Redux Toolkit, React Query). I work confidently with legacy code: I carry out refactoring, reduce technical debt and improve project maintainability.
about-page.description-5: I regularly participate in code reviews and technical interviews. He served as a leader: mentoring junior developers, coordinating the team, participating in the decomposition of tasks and making architectural decisions.
about-page.description-6: Additionally, I have experience in SEO, which allows me to take into account the requirements of search engines during development (SSR, rendering and loading optimization). I am currently expanding my competencies towards fullstack (Node.js ).
about-page.description-7: English is B1 (I read the documentation, I use it in my work).
